profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at engage2learn
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer. Skilled in building responsive and clean user interfaces in modern technologies

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Hired on as Front End Developer (Angular & Typescript), was formally trained in back-end API development (PHP, Yii2, SQL) and regularly contribute to full-stack feature development and bug fixes
• Contributed to development of new flagship platform from start to launch in less than 6 months, taking ownership of several core features and pages
• Made key decisions around development standards during initial stages (end-to-end testing, standardized code formatting, and CI/CD pipeline)
• Worked and trained in unit testing, state management, reporting, realtime collaboration, feature flag services, and activity feeds
• During a quality-focused quarter, helped reduce outstanding issues by over 90% (lowest in team's history)
• Regularly participate in agile ceremonies (scrum, grooming, sprint demos, retrospective, etc.)

positions.title: Interactive (React) Developer
positions.description:
• Acted and secondary (then primary) development resource for the agency's largest client, facilitating launch of two major web campaigns back-to-back
• Developed in a component-based architecture to ensure consistency in design, scalability, and user experience - used React (with Styled Components), Typescript, Express, GraphQL, Wordpress, & more
• Worked in several variations of headless CMS working in tandem with custom front-end, handling and displaying data passed between the two
positions.insights: Skills: React · HTML5 · SCSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · styled-components · GraphQL · WordPress · React.js · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Docker Products · TypeScript

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with project managers and designers to create and deploy responsive landing pages for clients' e-mail campaigns, following the company's established standards
• Developed and worked with Craft CMS
• Participated in peer code reviews and standardized git processes
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Wee

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with client's dev team to refresh the UI of a church management software; completed 20+ functional pages over the course of 8 months
• Marked up csHTML and SASS stylesheets in an ASP.NET codebase
• Contributed to a bootstrap-derived custom UI component kit used among developer team
• Original contract was intended for 3 months; the client requested multiple extensions that resulted in total contract of 8 months
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · HTML5 · SCSS · Bootstrap · C# · ASP.NET MVC · JavaScript

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Worked in a three-person dev team acting as sole front-end developer in a start-up environment
• Participated in agile project planning, utilizing git version control and standardized peer code review processes
• Contributed to custom web-apps for e-commerce pages, such as choose-your-own window treatments with instant previews
• In addition to HTML, CSS, and JS/jQuery, I worked with Magento 2 CMS, PHP, and MySQL
• Company unfortunately shut down three months into my start
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Magento · PHP · MySQL · JavaScript

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Act as the liaison between technology and design. Help clients understand the relationship between the two and how each can benefit the other.
• Involved in every step from ideation to a fully deployed website, including:
           Understanding business needs and purpose of a website
           Creation of UX/UI wireframes for proof of concept
           Development/coding of designs with consideration of stack, performance, and the elegance of how 
             things work
           Deployment of site of and maintenance to follow
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · SCSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Adobe Photoshop · JavaScript
